summary_md: **Runchao Han ([@runchao_han](https://x.com/runchao_han/status/2115711457249911287))** open-sources **Rustify**, agent skills that rebuild software from a stripped binary as idiomatic Rust while recovering specs, UX, architecture and tests and checking parity against the original; the follow-ups show a Rust Doom reconstruction that matches recorded scenarios, note support for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode, and credit the REA reverse-engineering tool it builds on ([SebastianElvis/rustify](https://github.com/SebastianElvis/rustify), [rustify-doom](https://github.com/SebastianElvis/rustify-doom), [morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea)).
